SuperSLM -- vendored source dependency

Tag:    v1.18.1
Commit: c3c14b16690a0c0c54de781f6f30380d88e62bd1
Base release commit: c3c14b16690a0c0c54de781f6f30380d88e62bd1
Release status: published release v1.18.1
Source repository: the upstream SuperSLM repository (not this repository)

The Tag line names the release and the Commit line the commit the tag points to (annotated tag object
e154c666bf6388c65edb5c69c19af4c77310074e).

1.18.1 is v1.18.0 plus one GPU fix: no D3D12 object is released by a static destructor. The process's GPU device,
the two pipeline caches, the shared root signature and the descriptor-table probe's pipeline live until the process
ends. In this plugin's editor and commandlets (a DLL host) the static destructors ran at the DLL's process detach,
after the D3D12 runtime had torn down, and the device's last release failed fast (0xC0000409): every editor or
commandlet process that had used the GPU crashed on a normal exit. Two library files change and a source lint and
its red suite are added (tests/ci/check_gpu_no_exit_destructors.py and its test), 1715 to 1717 files.

The pin moves from v1.15.0 to v1.18.0 across three releases:
- 1.16.0: GPU precached prefixes (sslm_gpu_prefix_save, sslm_gpu_prefix_restore) and
  SSLM_RESTORE_PRODUCER_MISMATCH on the GPU. This plugin still leaves SUPERSLM_WITH_GPU_PREFIX_SAVE at 0.
- 1.17.0: GPU schema fast-decode (the forced-text query, the GPU masked finish, sslm_gpu_seq_forced_tokens,
  sslm_gpu_seq_jump_forward, sslm_gpu_seq_embed_schema_token, sslm_gpu_seq_ready_for_logits; statuses 31 and
  32), and the Blackwell carry fix.
- 1.18.0: multi-row GPU dispatch (sslm_gpu_seq_embed_rows with the PROMPT and EXACT_DRAFT kinds,
  sslm_gpu_seq_rows_abandon, sslm_gpu_seq_rows_produced, SSLM_GPU_ROWS_CHUNK_OPEN), Exact on the GPU through
  sslm_gpu_seq_jump_forward, and the shipped cost table include/superslm/gpu_rows_cost_table.h, measured
  (ruling 37: kGpuRowsCostTableMeasured and kGpuRowsLogitsRatioMeasured are true; RX 7900 XT, 0.5B and 1.5B).
  Canonical jump-forward is removed on the CPU and the GPU (errata E-11): mode 0 is SSLM_JUMP_DEFAULT (Exact),
  so sslm_seq_jump_forward and sslm_gpu_seq_jump_forward with NULL options or mode 0 run Exact.
  CPU slice 2 adds the opt-in SSLM_PARALLEL_FOR_PREFILL bit (bit 0 of sslm_parallel_for.reserved); this
  plugin sets only SSLM_PARALLEL_FOR_MATVEC, so its behaviour and outputs are unchanged.
Release notes: CHANGELOG.md's 1.16.0, 1.17.0, 1.18.0 and 1.18.1 sections.

The distribution has 1718 files, excluding .github/ and this vendoring metadata. Each is byte-identical
to git show v1.18.1:<path>, except the five existing consumer-witness repairs
listed below (upstream did not change those five files between v1.15.0 and v1.18.1). Two upstream files
are stored with CRLF line endings (tests/multirow-gpu/p41_wine_baseline_*.txt); this repository's .gitattributes
marks them -text so they stay byte-identical. No library source is added since v1.15.0, so the wrapper set is
unchanged; the multi-row code is in src/gpu/gpu_1p0.cpp and the headers it includes.

Raw blobs were read through git ls-tree and git cat-file. The complete SHA-256 manifest
records every file and is checked by ci/check_vendored_tree_matches_manifest.py. The five local
witness/tool adaptations to SuperSLMFinishHook::Make are retained unchanged:
route_p_hook_witness.cpp, route_p_run_count.cpp, run_route_p_hook_witness.sh, run_merge_acceptance.sh,
and shim/CoreMinimal.h under tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/. Their hashes remain explicit. The
coherence check (.github/scripts/check_vendored_against_tag.py) reads these Repaired lines: a listed
file may differ from the tag, must still be present, and must actually differ; any other difference fails.
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/route_p_hook_witness.cpp
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/route_p_run_count.cpp
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/run_route_p_hook_witness.sh
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/run_merge_acceptance.sh
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/shim/CoreMinimal.h

History: the pin moved from the v1.18.0 tag to the v1.18.1 tag (c3c14b16) on 2026-10-31: the exit-destructor
fix above, the version bump to 1.18.1 and the release note; ten files change and three are added (1715 to 1718),
none removed. Before that it moved from the a7d6ac22 candidate to the v1.18.0 tag (6c380ec1) on 2026-10-28: CPU slice 2
(threaded batched passes, opt-in), the version bump to 1.18.0, SslmGpuStatus 33 final, the release notes and
review text fixes; 25 files change and 22 are added (1693 to 1715), none removed. Before that the candidate moved from dd1fc381 to a7d6ac22 on 2026-10-27 (rulings 46 and 46a: the one-row
device-logits finish and the device K/V restore add their GPU time to CumulativeGpuBusyUs and LastCallTiming,
instrumentation only, output bytes unchanged; nine files change, the file count does not). Before that it moved from 277682d4 to dd1fc381 on 2026-10-27 (ruling 45a: the engine-internal
cumulative GPU-busy counter, superslm_gpu::CumulativeGpuBusyUs() in gpu_port.h, instrumentation only and not in the
C ABI; four files change, the file count does not). The 1.18.0 candidate was first vendored from v1.15.0 on 2026-10-27 for plugin 1.4.0 (multi-row GPU plan
MR6, errata E-6), skipping v1.16.0 and v1.17.0 pins. v1.15.0 was vendored from v1.13.1 on 2026-10-24,
v1.13.1 on 2026-10-19, and v1.13.0 from v1.11.0 on 2026-10-15. No library source or existing test is removed.
Earlier source pins and the initial v1.2.0 import are retained in Git history.

What changed in this plugin for the pin: see CHANGELOG.md (1.4.0).

Saves: as at every pin, the Layer-1 tag in the save wrapper changes, so a save taken at the v1.15.0 pin is
refused Layer1Mismatch. An SPX1 prefix blob records its producer, so a cached prefix from another engine version
is refused SSLM_RESTORE_PRODUCER_MISMATCH and rebuilt by prefill (a cache miss, not an error).

**The first vendoring pass at v1.2.0 (2026-08-22) was corrected the same day**: `git archive`
on Windows applies `.gitattributes`' `text`/`eol=crlf`
line-ending rules exactly as a normal checkout would, so every `*.cpp`/`*.h`/`*.md`/etc. file
(marked `text`, tool-native on checkout) came out CRLF-converted -- 357 of 526 files differed
from the tag by line endings only, content unaffected. `git show <tag>:<path>` does not apply
this conversion -- it returns the raw blob -- so every re-vendoring since, including this one,
reads every file that way instead of via `git archive`.

This plugin never consumes a prebuilt SuperSLM binary. It builds this tree from source with the
engine's own toolchain, which is why
the full CMake project -- including its test and tool executables' source, not only include/
and the library sources -- is vendored: CMakeLists.txt declares those targets unconditionally
at configure time, and configure fails if their sources are absent.

Do not hand-edit Layer 1 engine files under this directory. A correction to SuperSLM is made upstream and
this tree is re-vendored at the new pin. The witness repairs above are tracked local exceptions.
`VENDORED_MANIFEST.sha256` records this tree's current per-file hashes, checked by
`ci/tests/test_vendored_tree_checks_run_in_ci.py` against the COMMITTED tree at every `ci/tests`
run -- an unrecorded edit that alters any file's content fails that check. (`ci/check_vendored_tree_matches_manifest.py` and
`ci/check_vendored_wrappers_complete.py` are the checkers; `ci/tests` runs them, and the
repository's coherence-checks workflow runs them too.)
